robusta-dev/holmesgpt "The CNCF SRE Agent" (Apache-2.0, ~2.6k stars, CNCF sandbox; created by Robusta.Dev with major Microsoft contributions; README read 2026-06-15). METHODOLOGY ONLY, no tool code bundled, HolmesGPT not run -> ai-rca-investigation-playbook.md. Adds the AI-driven reactive RCA loop the SRE lacked: agentic ALERT -> EVIDENCE -> ROOT-CAUSE -> RUNBOOK investigation. (1) Alert intake: start from the symptom with full label context + the runbook annotation (which the SLO-as-code specs already attach), restate precisely, sanity-check targets-up before trusting the signal. (2) Systematic multi-signal evidence-gathering, breadth-then-depth: metrics sliced by version/pod, logs (first new error class), events/'what changed' (deploys/config/scaling/OOM), traces (our-code-slow vs dependency-slow), dependency health (DB/queue/cache/upstream), change/PR timeline; read-only. (3) Root-cause synthesis as an evidence-cited causal chain trigger->mechanism->symptom, ranked hypotheses with explicit ruled-OUT, proximate vs root distinguished. (4) Runbook mapping: runbooks are a first-class evidence source (internal docs/alert annotation/public), follow+cite or seed a new one; write findings back to the alert/ticket/channel. Plus operator/continuous mode (post-deploy deployment-verification gate wired to the chaos steady-state, scheduled health checks; degrades to scripted synthetic on no-K8s client stacks), large-observability-data context discipline (server-side filter, narrowest discriminating slice, summarize - mirrors context-manager paging), and read-only/RBAC safety with remediation as a separate human-gated step. Gate-0 vs chaos-and-slo-as-code.md (proactive: chaos lifecycle + SLO-as-code) and promql-patterns.md (query cookbook): neither had a structured evidence-driven investigation loop from firing alert to named root cause - all net-new. HolmesGPT is host-installed/operated read-only; the playbook is runnable by hand against the same data sources (e.g. the already-wired prometheus-mcp). No em-dashes.
